description.value: Bikes For All is a full-service bike shop in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant area with over 4,000 square feet of space housing one of the city's largest selections of new and used bicycles. They stock touring and bikepacking bikes alongside panniers, racks, fenders, and other accessories that cycle tourists rely on. The shop also accepts bike donations for community refurbishment and operates a second location in New Westminster.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 7m; stands (2 spaces) at 34m; stands (2 spaces) at 40m; wave (6 spaces) at 83m. Total: 13 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Bikes For All is a full-service bike shop at 112 E 7th Ave, Vancouver. The service page states experienced mechanics work on any brand and offer free estimates, supporting the urgent-mechanicals criterion. Touring/bikepacking bikes and accessories (panniers, racks, fenders) are listed in the shop categories, confirming touring parts stocked. The service page explicitly mentions electric bike service ('Please bring your dual suspension and electric bikes into the store for a labour quote'). The FAQ confirms a rental fleet of over 20 bikes. No pump, DIY stand, washroom, water, or charging evidence was found on the website.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Full-service bike shop with walk-in repairs, touring parts, e-bike service, and rentals — a strong fit for touring cyclists passing through Vancouver.

Touring parts stocked.detail: Shop categories include Touring/Bike Packing used bikes, Touring/Steel new bikes, plus panniers, racks, fenders, saddles (including Brooks), and bar tape/grips

E-bike service.detail: Service page states 'Please bring your dual suspension and electric bikes into the store for a labour quote'; also sells e-bike kits

Bike rentals.detail: FAQ confirms 'We have a beautiful fleet of over 20 rental bikes available'; rentals are first come first serve, no reservations

wow_evidence: touring and bikepacking bikes alongside panniers, racks, fenders… second location in New Westminster
